Dana — thanks for the quick reply and for sharing the forecast. We can structure the redemption as a phased schedule that minimizes accounting friction while keeping throughput predictable for you and for our Dedicated capacity planning. High-level proposal (attached PDF):

- Tranche A (activation): 40% of committed credits available at private-offer activation date. Invoice issued monthly against realized consumption; credits applied at invoice settlement.
- Tranche B (60 days post-activation): 30% unlock tied to >=70% of projected utilization in first 60 days OR a calendar date (whichever comes first).
- Tranche C (120 days post-activation): remaining 30% unlocked, conditional on final acceptance and minimal fraud/compliance checks.

Operational notes:
- We will issue monthly invoices to AtlasHealth and apply marketplace credits as a reduction to the invoice line item; bookkeeping samples included in the attached plan.
- If utilization is materially below forecast (<50% of projected run rate at tranche B), we propose a 10% frontload buffer to preserve service continuity; we can reduce next tranche accordingly.
- For GCP activation we need the signed PO and the partner CloudResell's partner ID (so they can be assigned co-sell credits).

Next steps:
1) Confirm acceptance of the tranche percentages/timing or propose adjustments.
2) Ben / Marissa to share final signed PO and marketplace mapping.
3) GCP Marketplace to activate private offer PO-987654321 and register CloudResell as co-sell partner.

Attachments: redwood_po_redemption_plan_v1.pdf (pdf)

--
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Growth
Redwood Inference

Stephanie — quick internal note (replying-all would reveal our internal thinking to Atlas; keeping this internal).

- We need to confirm SKU mapping before we commit to applying credits at invoice level; GCP settlement sometimes posts credits at the marketplace payment cycle which can differ from our invoices. If credits arrive to the partner rather than directly adjusting Atlas' invoice, we need to ensure CloudResell will pass-through credits or we take the accounting hit.
- Suggest adding a short line in the SOW that credits will be applied on Redwood invoices and partner will reimburse any settlement timing delta. That protects Redwood cashflow and Atlas' P&L predictability.
- Also recommend a 10% buffer (as Steph suggested) but cap it explicitly in the PO text so finance can forecast the worst-case.

On the PO: once Ben has the signed PO we can include the clause and route to legal for a one-paragraph amendment.

Thanks,
Marissa
